issues: src/navigation/index.ts (line 1): The file contains "export { default } from './index';" which creates a circular import with itself (index.ts imports from './index' which resolves to the same file). This leads to a runtime stack overflow (Maximum call stack size exceeded) and a TypeScript compile error (TS2303). Fix by exporting the default from the correct file (e.g., "export { default } from './index.tsx';") or remove this file and import Navigation directly from './index.tsx'.

src/screens/PolicyScreen.tsx (line ~33-39): The Checkbox.Item component receives an "accessibilityState" prop which is not defined in its type definition, causing a TypeScript error (TS2322). Remove the "accessibilityState={{ checked }}" prop (or replace it with a supported prop such as "accessibilityLabel") to resolve the type error and allow the checkbox to be rendered correctly.

src/screens/PolicyScreen.tsx (line ~33-39): Because of the invalid prop, the policy screen fails to render the checkbox, causing the UI flow test to timeout when trying to locate the "I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy." field. After removing the invalid prop, ensure the checkbox remains accessible (e.g., by adding an appropriate "accessibilityLabel").
feedback: The acceptance tests passed, but static validation fails due to TypeScript compilation errors and a runtime stack overflow caused by a circular import in the navigation module. Additionally, the PolicyScreen uses an unsupported prop on Checkbox.Item, breaking the UI render and primary flow test. Fix the circular import and remove the invalid accessibilityState prop (or replace with a supported one). Once these issues are resolved, the project should compile, render UI correctly, and pass all static checks.
